name: Glyoxylate shunt branch
scope: Two reactions only: isocitrate cleavage, followed by glyoxylate + acetyl-CoA to L-malate. Not the enclosing glyoxylate cycle.
validation_status: automated_positive_negative_controls; independent human expert review pending
license: Original Atlas definitions; source references only, no KEGG/MetaCyc data redistributed
step_logic: All groups AND; nested two-element group OR of direct step versus listed AND substeps

ICL.protonation_policy: H+ differences ignored; water and all other coefficients exact

MS.protonation_policy: H+ differences ignored; water and all other coefficients exact

compartment_policy: All participating non-proton compounds in one compartment; exact model intermediate IDs shared between steps; transport routes not inferred
normalization: Coefficients proportional; ignores only proton stoichiometry, retains water, carbon and redox cofactors
